execution_contract.label_boundary: prepare one private coordinate/solvent input bundle containing no experimental target or error; the prediction process may open only that bundle

execution_contract.prediction_terminal: publish exactly one canonical complete-or-typed-failure label-free terminal artifact; any failed root or gate makes the panel a retained failure
execution_contract.scoring_boundary: after the prediction digest is frozen, a model-free and continuum-free mechanical scorer may read MNSol targets and create one private scored bundle
execution_contract.public_projection: derive aggregate-only public evidence from the private scored bundle in a separately retryable publication step
execution_contract.publication_durability: Every claim, terminal, private score, and public artifact uses O_TMPFILE byte verification, fsync(file), no-replace linkat, and fsync(parent directory); claim publication must return successfully before the first model evaluation.
execution_contract.orphan_recovery: The claim binds Linux boot_id, PID, and /proc start ticks. A different boot proves the claimed process dead; on the same boot, missing PID or different start ticks proves it dead. A dead claimed process without a terminal is permanently closed by a model-free aborted-unresolved terminal; scoring is forbidden and public failure projection remains available.
